source_review.default_boundary: Campaign rules are maintained per channel, country/site, store model, and ad account. AI may learn rules, calculate stackability, prepare calendars, and generate drafts; real campaign signup, discount creation, price change, coupon publish, ad launch, budget change, and external submission require confirmation.
implementation_policy: The AI checks channel, country site, store model, ad account, and route key before activity execution planning.
The backend activity execution plan returns missing prerequisites, required stack checks, backend task package readiness, and external-submit boundaries before any task is queued.
Campaign signup, discount creation, coupon activation, price change, budget change, refund, shipment, and authorization changes are never submitted autonomously.
When shared login or token usage can associate stores, create an isolated backend task package with screenshots, draft id, execution log, and ERP writeback evidence.

rules.label: TikTok Shop promotions
rules.notes: TikTok Shop promotions, Seller Center drafts, affiliate, Shop Ads/GMV Max and Business Center ownership must stay separated by country site, store model, ad account and execution identity. Partner Center/Open API exposes promotion-related surfaces, but real campaign signup, discount publish, ad launch and budget changes still require owner confirmation. Official full-managed remains recognition-only and is not executable.

rules.label: SHEIN marketplace campaigns
rules.notes: SHEIN Open Platform is primarily treated as product, order, fulfillment, stock preparation, webhook and reporting surface; marketplace, semi-managed cross-border/local, TeeLab co-ops and official full-managed labels must stay separated. Promotion or traffic actions without verified public write coverage stay as seller-hub/backend drafts plus owner confirmation. Official full-managed remains recognition-only and is not executable.

rules.label: Shopee campaigns
rules.notes: Shopee Open Platform has shop authorization and promotion-related surfaces such as discount/voucher directions, but Southeast Asia sites must be split by country; campaign, voucher, ads and affiliate execution should not be treated as one regional store or one shared identity.

rules.label: Lazada campaigns
rules.notes: Lazada Open Platform and Seller Center expose product/order/logistics/finance plus promotion directions such as Seller Voucher, Free Shipping and bundle-style tools, while Sponsored Solutions/ads stay a separate surface. Country-site campaign and promotion coverage can vary, so unresolved paths stay as drafts.

rules.label: Amazon promotions and ads
rules.notes: SP-API, Seller Central promotions/coupons/deals and Amazon Ads API are separate authorization surfaces. The AI may prepare drafts and evidence; coupon/deal submit, price change, ad launch and budget edits stay behind owner confirmation and isolated execution identity.

rules.label: Walmart marketplace promotions and ads
rules.notes: Marketplace seller APIs and Walmart Connect advertising are separate surfaces. Promotions, ads and budget changes require confirmation.

rules.label: Shopify discounts and campaigns
rules.notes: Each independent store has its own app scopes and discount permissions; ads are not part of store Admin API authorization. Confirmed tasks may use an isolated store backend package, but real discount activation and ad launch still require owner confirmation.

rules.label: WooCommerce coupons and store campaigns
rules.notes: WooCommerce coupons and sale prices depend on per-store REST keys/plugins; external ads stay separate.

rules.label: Meta Ads campaigns
rules.notes: Meta Ads uses Business/ad-account permissions. It is not unlocked by store ERP binding and must be isolated per ad account.

rules.label: Etsy shop promotions and ads
rules.notes: Etsy listing, inventory and order APIs do not equal permission to create sales, coupons or change Etsy Ads budgets. Shop Manager changes require confirmation.

rules.label: eBay promotions and promoted listings
rules.notes: eBay Sell Marketing API, Seller Hub promotions and Promoted Listings are separate from inventory/order sync. eBay decommissioned setupQuickCampaign and launchCampaign from the campaign resource, so campaign setup/launch stays draft plus owner confirmation instead of one-click execution.
